title.en: Healthcare Services (National University Hospital (Singapore) Pte Ltd — Exemption) Order 2023

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en:
1.—(1) This Order is the Healthcare Services (National University Hospital (Singapore) Pte Ltd — Exemption) Order 2023.
(2) This Order is in force for the period between 9 October 2023 and 1 November 2026 (both dates inclusive).
